title: Human Override
description: Mid-session human override. Zeus reads at the start of each turn (highest priority). Override is logged as ADR. See Part VIII of cursor-kit-v2-FINAL.md.

action.description: REDIRECT=update contract & re-dispatch. CANCEL=kill task & release locks. INJECT_DEPENDENCY=add to DAG. FORCE_PASS=manually approve gate. RESEQUENCE=rebuild DAG with new ordering.
